WHAT MINI SEES

You move.
Mini turns it into input.

Mini watches a defined area. A hand, a step, or a moving tool can become an input for an approved app.

CARE + MOTIONWalk through the area.
Mini records the movement.

Use the movement record to prototype training, ergonomics, or research tools.

RESEARCH + DEVELOPMENTMove a hand or tool.
Mini sends its position.

Feed physical movement into a robotics, interaction, or spatial-computing prototype.

EVERYDAY SPACERaise a hand.
Mini recognizes the trigger.

Let an approved app respond with a light, sound, or another hands-free action.

GAMEDodge or reach.
Mini makes it game input.

Pair with avokadoPro when the player's body and the room should become the controller.

Development concepts only. Medical, safety-critical, and production uses require separate validation.

1600 × 1200 mono8. A 1280 × 800, 60 fps center ROI is the current planning profile, subject to real-device validation.

RESERVED / INACTIVETwo dark exterior windows

They preserve the product face but do not represent two additional working cameras in E3.

CYAN LIGHT IS A VISUAL STATUS EFFECT, NOT MEASURED SENSOR OUTPUT

02 / FIXED PRODUCT ENVELOPE

No extension.
No hidden scale change.

The proposed assembled height is 199.50 ± 0.45 mm. The 199.95 mm arithmetic maximum leaves only 0.05 mm, so measurement method and production margin remain open.

HEIGHT ≤ 200 MM / Ø44 MM BODY / NON-TELESCOPING E3

03 / LOW-PROFILE PEDESTAL

Stable below.
Clean from every angle.

A wide circular pedestal replaces exposed outriggers with a concealed anti-slip ring. Floor friction, cable pull, and tip resistance remain physical tests before production.

TIP, SLIDE, HEAT, AND CABLE-STRAIN ACCEPTANCE: NOT RUN
